source_text: Klagel. Jerem. 2, 6. Σκηνὴν μὲν τὸν ναόν, ἅμπελον δὲ καὶ ἀμπελῶνα λέγει τὸν Ἱσραὴλ κατὰ τὸ «ἄμπελον ἐξ Αἰγύπτου μετῆρας« παρὰ Δαβίδ, καὶ «ἀμπελὼν ἀμπελὼν ἐγενήθη τῷ ἠγαπημένῳ« παρὰ Ἡσαΐᾳ. καὶ Δαβὶδ μὲν ἐπάγει · «ἵνα τί καθεῖλες τὸν φραγμὸν αὐτῆς;« καὶ τὰ ἑξὴς, ὁ δὲ Ἠσαΐας· «ἀφεῖλες τὸν φραγμὸν αὐτοῦ« καὶ τὰ ἐπὶ τούτῳ. ταῦτα καὶ ὁ παρὼν ἐδήλωσε Θρῆνος. συστείλας γὰρ ἑαυτοῦ τὴν φρουρὰν ὁ θεὸς τοῖς πολεμίοις παρέδωκεν, οὐκέτιο κύκλῳ αὐτοῦ παρεμβάλλον- τος x003E; διὰ τὸ μὴ φοβεῖσθαι τὸν x003C;. κατήργησε δὲ καὶ τοὺς κατὰ νόμον εἰς λατρείαν καιρούς, ὡς ἔν Ἡσαΐᾳ φησί· «νηστείαν καὶ ἀργείαν καὶ τὰς ἑορτὰς ὑμῶν μισεῖ ἡ ψυχή μου. ὅπερ λήθην ἐκάλεσεν, ἀλλ’ οὐχ ὡς πάθος ἀνθρώπινον. παρώξυνε δὲ βασιλέα καὶ ἱερέα, ἀγανακτοῦντας εἰ μερὶς ὄντες θεοῦ τοιαῦτα παρ’ ἀσε- βούντων ὑφίστανται.
pass_a_gloss: Tent he calls the temple, and vine and ampelōn / vineyard Israel according to “a vine from Egypt you removed” in David, and “a ampelōn / vineyard came to be for the beloved” in Isaiah. And David adds: “why did you take down its fence?” and what follows; and Isaiah: “you removed its fence” and the things upon this. These things the present Lament also has shown. For God, having drawn together his own guard, handed them over to the enemies, no longer encamping round about him because of not fearing the Lord. And he has also abolished the times according to law unto worship, as in Isaiah he says: “fast and rest and your feasts my soul hates”—which he called a forgetting, but not as a human passion. And he provoked king and priest, being indignant if, being a portion of God, they undergo such things from the impious.
pass_b_english: Tent he calls the temple, and vine and vineyard Israel according to “a vine from Egypt you removed” (Psalm 80:12) in David, and “a vineyard came to be for the beloved” (Lamentations 2:6) in Isaiah. And David adds: “why did you take down its fence?” (Isaiah 5:1) and what follows; and Isaiah: “you removed its fence” (Isaiah 5:5) and the things upon this. These things the present Lament also has shown. For God, having drawn together his own guard, handed them over to the enemies, no longer encamping round about him because of not fearing the Lord. And he has also abolished the times according to law unto worship, as in Isaiah he says: “fast and rest and your feasts my soul hates” (Psalm 80:8)—which he called a forgetting, but not as a human passion. And he provoked king and priest, being indignant if, being a portion of God, they undergo such things from the impious (Isaiah 1:13–14).

choices.why: Origen’s Lam 1:22 turns on punitive-yet-healing divine visitation.
